title: Holy Spirit, Ever Dwelling
description: Holy Spirit, Ever Dwelling in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 3 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Timothy Rees, first published in 1922. The tune, EBENEZER, is by Thomas J. Williams (1890). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: Ho-ly__ Spir-it, ev-er__ dwel_-ling in the__ ho_-liest realms_ of light Ho-ly__ Spir-it, ev-er__ brood_-ing o'er a__ world_ of gloom_ and blight Ho-ly__ Spir-it, ev-er__ rais-ing earth-bound__ souls to glo-ry__ high Liv__-ing, life‑ im-part-ing__ Spir_-it you we__ praise_ and mag_-ni-fy.

lines: in the holiest realms of light
o'er a world of gloom and blight
on the church the breath of life
in the church the mind of Christ
In our worship we will praise you
for your fruit and gifts unpriced.
age to age and soul to soul
